**On-call handoff — gateway 503s**

**Root cause.** Deploy `dep-4471` (gateway, a.novak, 02:12–02:14 UTC) shipped a config change enabling `gateway.pool.perRequest` (`false → true`), applied as generation 119 at 02:13:41. That setting pins a DB connection per request instead of sharing the pool, so the pool (size 20) fills up and stays full. Every 503 since then logs the same underlying error: `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED acquiring connection from pool (size 20, in_use 20, waiting N)`.

**Impact window.** First 503 at 02:14:18 UTC, one minute after the deploy applied. Still ongoing as of the last log line at 03:59:27 UTC — the waiting queue has climbed to 74 and never recovered on its own. Gateway only. `worker.log` stayed clean the whole time, pool steady at `size=8 in_use=1 idle=7 waiting=0`.

**Roll back.** `dep-4471` on gateway — revert `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `false`. No other deploy in the window is implicated: `dep-4472` (billing-svc, 02:41) and `dep-4473` (catalog-svc, 03:20) landed after the errors began and don't touch pooling.
